summary: The released game now initializes projectile, homing and bouncing moves with one projectile and a narrow base spread before applying upgrades. The twelve previously affected moves now gain their extra projectile; their evolution requirements are unchanged.

groups.note: The level-2 upgrade now increases one projectile to two; the level-5 upgrade increases two to three. Each upgrade also uses the corrected spread.
The level-5 upgrade now increases one projectile to two and adds a bounce. Projectile count and bounce count are separate effects.
